characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art sprite animation sheet for a top-down cozy office game.
Reference image 1 is the exact existing character identity/proportion/color reference. Reference image 2 is the office scene style reference. Draw NEW animation frames of only this same character.
Create a strictly aligned 8-COLUMN by 16-ROW SPRITE SHEET: exactly 128 full-body sprites. Output canvas 1024 x 2048 pixels, each invisible grid cell exactly 128 x 128 pixels. No visible grid, no text, no labels. Actual transparent background including gutters. Each sprite remains fully isolated inside its cell, centered on x=64, planted feet baseline y=112 inside cell, ample padding. Character height about 86 pixels standing; don't crop arms or raised hands. Every row contains eight coherent chronological animation frames, left to right. Exact same character scale and palette throughout. Crisp hand-placed square pixel clusters, hard edges, restrained warm shading, tiny expressive faces, dark colored outlines, big head/small body exactly like references; no smooth vector style, no painterly softness, no antialiased edges, no 3D. Authentic top-down 3/4 RPG projection. No environment, chairs, desks or monitors; seated rows contain just floating seated character ready for separate furniture.
ROWS, strictly top to bottom:
1 idle facing DOWN / front, slow breathing, brief blink.
2 idle facing UP / back, slow breathing, slight head tilt.
3 idle facing RIGHT / profile, subtle breath and blink.
4 idle facing LEFT / profile, subtle breath and blink.
5 WALK DOWN / front: complete smooth 8-frame gait with alternating left and right legs, planted contact, passing and swing; gentle opposing arms and hair secondary motion.
6 WALK UP / back: same 8-frame gait away from camera.
7 WALK RIGHT: complete 8-frame gait in profile.
8 WALK LEFT: complete 8-frame gait in profile.
9 WORK SEATED facing RIGHT: typing with hands extended, alternating fingers/wrists, concentration and small head nod; no chair, keyboard or desk.
10 WORK SEATED facing LEFT: typing coherent loop, same proportions; no furniture.
11 DRINK COFFEE facing front 3/4: hold small white ceramic mug, raise to lips, sip with closed eyes, lower mug, pleasant smile.
12 TALK facing front 3/4: animated mouth and conversational alternating hand gestures, pleasant engaged expression.
13 LAUGH facing front: visible joyful eyes closed, mouth smiling open, shoulders bounce and hand to belly, slight lean then recover.
14 CELEBRATE facing front: anticipation, bend knees, BOTH ARMS UP, small joyful hop, peak with hands up, land and recover; no confetti baked into character.
15 WAVE facing front: raise right hand, friendly three wave oscillations, lower hand, blink.
16 THINK facing front 3/4: touch chin, tilt head, look up, small nod and return.
Give every action a readable distinct silhouette, expressive timing and charming character acting. Walk and idle loops return smoothly to frame 1. Keep action frames aligned and with same costume. Transparent pixels must be truly alpha zero. Do not paint checkerboard.
Subject identity: brown-haired male office manager, neat chestnut hair, navy suit jacket and navy trousers, white shirt, blue necktie, black shoes. Preserve the manager's blue necktie, suit lapels and brown hairstyle.
